summary: Frontend-only testing of the Biglyp hub brand-switch bug fix, header/title, hero image and mobile. Clicking through the product cards in the app (hub cards and product tab bar) now works when signed in as fe-aarav, mm-diya, me-riya and adm-platform, and when signed out. CRITICAL REGRESSION: when a signed-in student or counsellor loads another product's landing page directly (typing the URL, refreshing, opening a bookmark or a new tab), they get a completely BLANK page. A direct load of '/?p=<other>' shows the card selected but no product panel. Both come from a race between the page setting the brand and the auth restore in auth.jsx overriding it.

ui_bugs.issue: Signed-in fe-aarav doing page.goto('/mindedge'), '/mindmellow' or '/equimind' gets a blank page: landing-page count is 0, theme stays indigo. Same for mm-diya on '/focusedge'. Only the user's own product renders.

Signed-in fe-aarav loading '/?p=mindmellow' directly: hub-product-mindmellow is aria-selected but no hub-product-panel-* is rendered, theme is indigo and the header says 'Sign in to FocusEdge'. When signed out the same URL works.

issues: Header button reads 'Sign in to <brand>' even when the user is already signed in. Minor.
The admin header logo/brand keeps whichever product was last browsed (e.g. MindEdge). The admin page itself is not affected.

rca of the issue: Cause: on a full page load, ThemeProvider picks the brand from the URL path (initialBrand). Landing/BiglypHome run useEffect(setBrand(brand)), which does nothing because the brand already matches. Then /auth/me finishes, user.id changes from null to an id, and the auth.jsx effect runs setBrand(user.programme), switching to the user's own brand. Landing's effect depends only on [brand] and BiglypHome's only on [sel], so neither runs again. Landing then returns null because B.key !== brand, and BiglypHome hides the panel because B.key !== sel. Clicking within the app works because the user is already loaded by then. Reproduce: sign in as fe-aarav, then open /mindedge in a new tab or refresh it, and you get a blank page. Fix (recommended): remove the setBrand effect from auth.jsx completely. AppHeader already re-applies the user's brand on signed-in pages, and Login pages set their own brand. Alternative: add B.key to the deps of the Landing/BiglypHome effects and re-apply when B.key !== brand.
action_items: CRITICAL: fix the blank landing page when a signed-in user loads another product's URL directly. Remove the setBrand useEffect in frontend/src/lib/auth.jsx, since AppHeader already covers signed-in pages, or make Landing/BiglypHome re-apply their brand when B.key changes.
Fix signed-in direct load of '/?p=<other product>' showing no panel (same root cause).
Optional: on the hub, change 'Sign in to X' to 'Go to dashboard' when the user is already signed in.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.jsx effect [user?.id, user?.programme] still runs once when the session is restored after a page load, which overrides public pages that set their brand on mount. This is the source of the regression.
Landing.jsx 'if (B.key !== brand) return null' with an effect keyed only on [brand] leaves the page blank for good if anything else changes the brand afterwards.
passed_checks: Signed-in fe-aarav/mm-diya/me-riya/admin, clicking hub cards in mixed order: aria-selected, ?p=<key>, colours (indigo/ocean/lavender/sky) and panels are all correct (23/23)
Signed in, clicking product tabs from /focusedge: each tab shows its own brand name and theme (fe-aarav, me-riya)
/dashboard after browsing other products: fe-aarav is indigo/FocusEdge, me-riya is ocean/MindEdge; me-rahul /counsellor is ocean/MindEdge
Signed out: hub 5/5, reload of ?p=mindmellow keeps MindMellow, product tabs work
Hero /how/biglyp_hero.webp?v=4 loads (1264x848): calm illustration of 4 seated students on white, no blurred coloured shapes (only the small card with backdrop-blur)
Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow; tapping a card scrolls the panel to the top
context_for_next_testing_agent: After the fix, retest DIRECT loads (page.goto, not clicks) while signed in: fe-aarav -> /mindedge, /mindmellow, /equimind, '/?p=mindmellow'; mm-diya -> /focusedge. Also re-check that /dashboard still uses the user's brand.
